data.summary: Live, SW-live-smoke box1: launched with --dir on a linked worktree lane-wt (branch lane/smoke-toy), the lane's ddflow_claim answered how=created, here=false and made .ddflow/worktrees/smoke-toy, because the lane's MCP entry pins --repo to the primary. The pre-tool hook is rooted at the launched tree, so the lane's write into the tree claim named was refused as outside the lane worktree, and the commit in lane-wt left the item's branch empty, so the gate record was refused until the lane rebound itself with ddflow_task update worktree. Passing the item's default tree path and branch as Request.worktree avoids it (boxes 2 to 9). A launcher must do that or claim must adopt the lane's tree.
data.title: A lane's claim makes a second worktree instead of binding the one it was launched in

data.summary: Live, SW-live-smoke box11 on shipped defaults: kilo's first stream line comes about 20 s after start (MCP server and plugin load), so a 5 s idle ended collection before any event: level 0, no started event, and the lease was 'revoked' before the lane had claimed it. data.summary: Live, SW-live-smoke box1: a refused gate record came back with state.status completed and the refusal only in state.output ({"refusal":{...,"exit":3}}). STREAM_RULES map only part.state.error, so conformance._ok sees no error and a lane whose every claim, heartbeat or gate record was refused would pass levels 2 to 4. A heartbeat answering renewed:false is the same. services/lanes/smoke.py reads the output and separates them; the conformance grade does not.
data.title: Conformance counts a refused ddflow call as a success: a refusal arrives as a completed tool call

data.summary: endpoint.resolve refuses a route with no verified tool_call, and launch() gives no way to pass require_tools=False, which OC.prepare has. So the first live probe of any route cannot go through launch(): SW-live-smoke had to write tool_call as verified in the sandbox's local catalog BEFORE the evidence existed. A probe route needs its own explicit path, not a false fact.
data.title: launch() refuses a route whose tool_call is unverified, and a launch is the only way to verify it

data.summary: SW-live-smoke read kilo 7.8.18 run --format json live: step_start, tool_use and error match STREAM_RULES field for field (error.data.message read on a 404), so FACTS can say verified for kilo. Also: step_finish carries part.tokens and part.cost, so usage can be advertised; step_start comes once per model turn, so the 'started' event repeats; step_finish and text lines are skipped. The raw error line carries the endpoint URL in metadata.url and responseBody: the rules drop them today, and any rule added must keep them out. See docs/ddflow/research/swarm-smoke.md.

data.summary: Live, SW-live-smoke: `ddflow --agent box-op release smoke-toy` returned 0 and ended lane-kilo-1's live lease; foreign_guard only stops another CLONE. It worked as the smoke's revocation, but with lanes sharing one clone, one lane's release call drops a peer's lease and the peer's writes start to be refused. Release of another agent's lease should need force and a reason as for a clone, or a named lead revoke.
data.title: Any agent on the same clone can release another agent's live lease with no force and no reason

data.budget: about 15 minutes of LAN model time, keyless endpoints, no paid calls
data.claim: A real kilo lane on a keyless LAN model completes every lane step in a sandbox, its pre-tool hook refuses real calls, and its tool calls are well formed at 0.9 or better.
data.falsifier: A lane cannot finish the steps, a write after revocation goes through, or under 0.9 of calls are well formed.
data.mechanism: launch() writes a lane-private provider, MCP entry and plugin under a private HOME; the model reaches ddflow through MCP and the lease hook runs inside kilo before each tool.
data.probe: scratchpad sw-smoke/drive.py on 11 throwaway sandbox repos, then sw-smoke/judge_all.py with services/lanes/smoke.py over the raw kilo streams and sandbox event logs
data.probe_output: Run 2: every step clean in 30 s. Runs 3 to 7: conformance level 6 of 7, lease_stop passed, write after revocation refused with 'holds no live lease'. Runs 8, 9: other.txt refused by the plugin, sneaky.txt refused at commit. Runs 1 to 9: 86 calls, 1 bad (flash 61/1, pro 25/0). Run 1 needed a detour (B7d091d0f35). Run 11 on shipped conformance defaults: level 0 (B72bcd17b4e).
data.question: Can one kilo 7.8.18 lane on a keyless LAN model claim, edit, commit, heartbeat, record a gate and stop at its lease in a sandbox, with reliable tool calls?

data.body:
D-swarm-pilot-2026-11-05. Nothing has ever run against a live model. Prove one real lane end to end: claim, edit, commit, heartbeat, gate record, stop at the lease. Provides the ddflow lanes smoke route that opencode.py names (Ba655b17982) and sets tool_call_reliable from evidence. Operator consent to this run is recorded. Adopt what B-ac-smoke plans rather than a second runner.

RESULT 2026-11-05: GO for SW-pilot-toy, with conditions. Stopped by the unwind order D-unwind-for-kilo-2026-11-05: NOT merged. Full evidence: docs/ddflow/research/swarm-smoke.md on branch ddflow/SW-live-smoke, commit 4a5c87000; research R4faa82dbf9.

Evidence: kilo 7.8.18 on two keyless LAN DeepSeek models, 11 throwaway sandbox repos. Claim, edit, commit, heartbeat, gate record and stop worked; a clean run took 30 s. Conformance reached level 6 of 7 in 5 of 5 runs, with sandbox timings. The plugin refused real calls live: a write outside the globs and a write after revocation, and both models then stopped. A shell-written file was refused at commit. Tool calls: 86, 85 well formed (flash 61/1, pro 25/0). The stream matches STREAM_RULES, error shape included. Toy items and short runs only.

How it was driven: a sandbox test harness called launch() directly and stubbed both person approvals in memory only; nothing was written to a log as a person's act. tool_call was asserted verified in the sandbox catalog before the evidence existed (Bc64f9048f5).

Conditions: B7d091d0f35 (a lane must get the item's own tree), B72bcd17b4e (conformance defaults give level 0 on a live lane), B09100a25b3 and B6eaa5f27c2 (level 7 unreachable; refused calls count as success), B8478a28c60 (any agent on a clone can release a peer's lease). Also B59a07c283d, B34e7a7001f (low). Still open from before: B5c8139e564, B8647b69e06, Ba655b17982.

Not delivered: `ddflow lanes smoke` (outside this item's globs, and it is launcher work). No route fact was written: there is no .ddflow/local/models.toml here; smoke.tool_call_fact gives verified true for both routes.

To resume: gates research, rules and implement passed. rubber_duck and critic did not run: one combined review was cut off by my 560 s timeout with no result, so it is neither passed nor failed. Then standards, ci, unit_tests, bug_hunt, dedupe, merge. Baseline-red, not this item: tests/test_no_agent_literals.py (kind_security.py) and tests/test_arch_deps.py (approvals.harness) fail the same with this item's files removed. The harness scripts are in the session scratchpad under sw-smoke and are temporary.
